subject.title: [Feature]: feat(session-memory): Add auto-trigger on idle, shutdown, and periodic checkpoints

question: Which automatic session-memory lifecycle contract should OpenClaw support for idle rollover, shutdown, periodic checkpoints, and summary output?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent choice affects plugin-visible hook behavior, shutdown deadlines, new config surface, transcript retention, and provider-based summarization privacy.

options.title: Refine the daily/idle PR first
options.body: Accept or replace the active daily/idle PR as the narrow first step, then design shutdown, periodic, and summary modes separately.

options.title: Define one memory-finalization API
options.body: Pause piecemeal reset work and design a typed lifecycle or plugin API that covers rollover, shutdown, prune, and checkpoints in one contract.

options.title: Keep automation outside bundled core
options.body: Limit core to documented hook surfaces and require a plugin/ClawHub package to own trigger policy and summarization behavior.

recommendation.title: Refine the daily/idle PR first
recommendation.body: Accept or replace the active daily/idle PR as the narrow first step, then design shutdown, periodic, and summary modes separately.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent history in the session-memory and reset-hook surface and is already connected to the active candidate repair path.
